instruction: You are given an orthotropic material template `/home/user/Desktop/aniso_base.inp`. Complete the following from the command line: 1. Modify and generate `/home/user/Desktop/aniso.inp`: Please save the final input file as /home/user/Desktop/aniso.inp. - Define local coordinate system: X' along beam axis (global X), Y' along global Y - Update `*Solid Section` to reference `Ori-1` - Fix one end and apply `FY=-100 N` on the other end 2. Submit the job and write a post-processing script to parse `aniso.dat`: - Extract global maximum Mises stress - Extract free-end `U2` - Write to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` in this format: `max_mises, tip_u2` 4. Do not use the CGX GUI. [Software] Run `ccx --version` or invoke the installed `ccx` binary from a terminal. For this workflow, use `/usr/bin/ccx` for the CalculiX solve and `/usr/bin/cgx` when CGX processing is needed.
